title: Inexorable Soul
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Inexorable Soul · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=122631147

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 22cost

Theme 1

The Reaper

Tier 1Cost 1

When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP with an instance of damage, you may use your bonus action to convert the overflow damage to THP

Full original wording

The death of your foes is not their final breath, but the first spark of your relentless fury. When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP with an instance of damage, you may use your bonus action to convert the overflow damage to THP

Tier 2Cost 2

You may take a -5 penalty to attack rolls, and on a hit, the target cannot heal until the start of your next turn

Full original wording

Enemies wounded by your hand bear scars that no magic or medicine can erase. You may take a -5 penalty to attack rolls, and on a hit, the target cannot heal until the start of your next turn

Tier 3Cost 3

When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP on a critical hit made with a melee strength or dexterity based attack, you refresh your movement and gain one additional attack.

Full original wording

Your momentum is a force of nature; obstacles crumble, enemies falter, but you press on unyielding. When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP on a critical hit made with a melee strength or dexterity based attack, you refresh your movement and gain one additional attack.

Theme 2

The Timeless

Tier 1Cost 1

You may also ask the DM if they are missing something with a history check, once per long rest.

Full original wording

Time speaks to you in whispers; you hear echoes of forgotten eras and the footsteps of civilizations long gone. For one minute, all allies you can see have advantage on history checks. Once you use this ability, you cannot again until you complete a long rest. You may also ask the DM if they are missing something with a history check, once per long rest.

Tier 2Cost 2

You may take as many reactions as you want per round. Each reaction beyond the first the first must pass DC 15 Con Check, which grows by 5 each subsequent attempt. Once you fail, you cannot take any more reactions until the start of your next turn.

Full original wording

Moments stretch and compress at your whim, letting you weave through chaos with uncanny precision. You may take as many reactions as you want per round. Each reaction beyond the first the first must pass DC 15 Con Check, which grows by 5 each subsequent attempt. Once you fail, you cannot take any more reactions until the start of your next turn.

Tier 3Cost 3

You walk through a silent world, a lone force in a stopped clock, shaping the outcome before time resumes. As an action, you can come under the effects of the Time Stop spell. Once you do so you cannot do so for another seven days.

Full original wording

You walk through a silent world, a lone force in a stopped clock, shaping the outcome before time resumes. As an action, you can come under the effects of the Time Stop spell. Once you do so you cannot do so for another seven days.

Theme 3

The Flawless

Tier 1Cost 1

You are immune to the command spell, and all other such spells of 2nd level and below

Full original wording

Words meant to bind or break you fall away like whispers on stone—powerless and forgotten. You are immune to the command spell, and all other such spells of 2nd level and below

Tier 2Cost 2

You are immune to being possessed, such as the Ghost's attack

Full original wording

Your identity is your own, a flame no shadow can extinguish or consume. You are immune to being possessed, such as the Ghost's attack

Tier 3Cost 3

When the reincarnation spell is used on you, you may choose what race you come back as. Whenever you are ressurected by any means, your body has no deformities suffered from dying and you ignore normal penalties from being ressurected. Also, roll a DC 20charisma save, and on a success it doesn't count towards your death count.

Full original wording

Your soul’s fire fuels your body’s strength, and your body’s resolve anchors your soul’s essence. When the reincarnation spell is used on you, you may choose what race you come back as. Whenever you are ressurected by any means, your body has no deformities suffered from dying and you ignore normal penalties from being ressurected. Also, roll a DC 20charisma save, and on a success it doesn't count towards your death count.
